name: inner_pointForm
summary: The inner product is a class sum of pointwise Gram pairings, and the class sum of a delta form against φ is the value at its point.

steps.claim: The inner product of level forms is the class sum of the pointwise Gram pairings (innerAt_eq_stdClassSum).
By classSum_deltaForm, the class sum of L(g)(δ(g)) with L(g) = (· ↦ gramForm(·, φ(g))) equals L(x)(v), provided the equivariance hypothesis holds.

The equivariance holds: φ transforms under the level and the rational points by the level character and the weight representation (levelSpace_smoothFormRep_apply), the Gram form is invariant under the conjugate weight representation (gramForm_conjWeylRep), and the level character has absolute value 1 (finite order).
steps.lean:
simp [↓levelSpace_smoothFormRep_apply φ.2, gramForm_conjWeylRep, ← mul_assoc, Complex.conj_mul',
    -MonoidHom.coe_comp, weightRep_apply, (LevelPlaces.isOfFinOrder_level_char _).norm_eq_one]
